records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli
evidence: result:the plugin moved from 0.54.1 to 0.54.2 for scope user; the installed copy records gitCommitSha b79b5d59512caf890afd09d430b78b5be21ed2f7 -- the v0.54.2 tag commit

records.subject: spec-guard-0.54.2-claude-copy
evidence: command:<installed>/hooks/setup-convention.sh and teardown-convention.sh (default Claude host) against the fixture CLAUDE.md
command:a fresh git fixture; setup-convention local (first install), then a local section `<!-- BEGIN:spec-guard-local -->` with one line added before the block END marker
result:teardown-convention exited 0 without --accept-removals; the local line stayed where the block was, no spec-guard marker remained, and .agent/state.json became state.json.disabled

result:after a fresh install with one hand-written line outside the local section, teardown-convention exited 1, listed that line and mentioned --accept-removals; the instruction file hash and the .agent directory were unchanged
result:teardown-convention --accept-removals exited 0, removed the hand-written line, left the local line in place and disabled state.json
